job.style_qa: мультяшный (НЕ фотореализм — так задумано) персонаж по пояс, лицом к зрителю, рот слегка приоткрыт, без текста и цифр; стиль: мягкий 3D, как в мультфильмах студии Pixar; Саша ~28, худой, растрёпанный, большой свитер, очки
job.person_note: An original cartoon character, not based on any real person or existing franchise character.
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A lanky young Russian guy named Sasha about 28, tousled light-brown hair, round glasses, an oversized teal knit sweater, holding a long paper receipt. Background: a small messy rented flat in simple shapes, a pile of envelopes with bills on the table, a laptop, a houseplant. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, the character from the waist up, centred, facing the viewer, both shoulders and hands in frame, face large and clearly drawn, top of head about 22% below the upper edge (leave the top fifth calm and simple for a game HUD), looking straight at the viewer, mouth slightly open mid-sentence, a sheepish worried-but-hopeful expression. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

attempts.issue: Remove pseudo-text from the receipt and documents
